'''Balmai Wyngarde''' was a [[Baroness/Legends|Baroness]] of [[House Melantha]] that governed the [[Melantha Province]] of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]].

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] was a mature woman and she believed that the Tapani Sector was the last bastion of culture in the Galaxy, particularly after the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. She held no love for [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].
